integrity: The marked Poisson limit and all-moment consequence are established by a direct alternating-exponential interval coupling and an independent matrix Feynman-Kac transform calculation. Numerical verification is supplementary. General Markov-additive ladder theory predates this specialization; an independent priority and proof assessment has not been performed.
limitations: One spatial dimension, symmetric two-state orientation flips of fixed positive rate, fixed positive speed and positive finite spatial window; infinite-physical-time first-arrival coloring and only the one-sided positive ray. The singular weak-diffusivity limit does not include bounded observation times, interacting tracer paint, zero propulsion, or joint right/left color fields.
title: Poisson micropaint islands in a weakly diffusive run-and-tumble trajectory
